mostWorthwhile.text: Ren's installed stop test was the most worthwhile: it confirmed that the pump actually stops without the network, beyond merely testing the button on the bench.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to connect the prepared stop directly to the cabinet was a confusing detour; it needed a separate rig test first, which had not been obvious to me.

surprise.text: I expected the service kit to help check the flow sensor, but it instead replaced the failed remote-permission relay with a supported local-control board.

arbitrary.text: The final radio link's purpose made sense once revealed, but it was not clear to me that it was required to complete the goal after Ren had returned the pump to operation.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the neighborhood extends its network, though the repeated preparation and testing steps could become predictable.
